title: 第17章 天崩开局第18章 疑似混沌灵根
content_zh:
陈晓云一听顿时无语了，温柔笑着回答道：“师姐，你又来！你能不能老是一直提这个啊，我都听了多少遍了。”李雨彤一听，脸上露出委屈问道：“晓云，怎么？有了弟弟后，难道我们的关系就变了吗？你以前可不是这样的，明明我们那么要好的。”
陈晓云见状无奈摇摇头，温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，你别相信师姐的表情，师姐就是这个样子，简直太能演了。”李雨彤一听顿时有些尴尬，笑着说道：“弟弟，你可不要信你姐姐说的，我可不是这样的人，明明人家那么淑女，怎么会像你姐姐说的那般呢！”
姬云生一听，心里喃喃道：“我也是醉了，这小丫头片子，怎么话那么多，就这演戏水平，放在地球简直太差劲了。不过看她说了那么多，第一眼的感受就是，她如此性格应该是，因为在皇宫呆久了，才会如此。应该不是个坏人，最多就是个古灵精怪的公主而已。”
李雨彤笑着问道：“晓云，弟弟怎么都不理我呀？难道我就这么魅力差吗？”陈晓云没好气，笑着温柔回答道：“师姐，弟弟这才半岁啊，你和他说那么多，他又不会说话，你让他怎么回答你呢？”李雨彤一听，笑着说道：“不对呀！我看弟弟能听懂我们说话的，
他应该天赋肯定强的，怎么还不会说话呢？就以弟弟这么有灵性而言，就算是半岁也应该会说话了呀！”陈晓云温柔笑着回答道：“师姐，弟弟确实能听懂我们说话，他才出生不久，就已经能听懂我们说话了。我也问过弟弟，他自己都不知道怎么回事，
我怎么会知道呢？不过要是弟弟愿意搭理你的话，他会写字回答你的，不然的话，我就没有办法了。”李雨彤一听，有些惊讶笑着问道：“嗯？弟弟已经会读书写字了吗？”陈晓云温柔笑着回答道：“是的，弟弟我才叫他识字一个晚上，他就已经学会了基础的全部文字了。
这半年时间以来，弟弟不仅能读书写字，还把我会的40多套凡人武学，都已经学会了。”李雨彤一听，顿时吓了一跳，笑着说道：“真是个小变态啊，这天赋简直闻所未闻！”这时，洛冰儿的声音传来说道：“你们两个还不把小弟弟带来测试，整天就知道闲聊。”
两人一听顿时不继续聊了，连忙赶紧带着姬云生去找洛冰儿，就这语气，她们两个可是听出，洛冰儿有些生气的语气了。十秒时间过去，两人就带着姬云生来到洛冰儿的寝室了，紧张的齐声笑着说道：“师尊好！我们来晚了，让您久等了。”
洛冰儿见两人就来气，毕竟两个小丫头，比她自己还要顽皮活泼，她自己都烦的很。洛冰儿缓缓走了过来，然后手掌抬起，凭空出现了块犹如晶莹剔透的水晶，看着姬云生温柔说道：“小弟弟，你把手放在上面贴住就好，等会儿就知道你的天赋了。”
姬云生一听小手也是贴上水晶之上，这时，水晶突然亮了起来，那刺眼的光芒在房间之中闪烁，缓缓的形成了金色、红色、蓝色、绿色和黄色五种颜色的光芒，又过去一会儿，光芒的强度不再上升了。洛冰儿温柔有些可惜说道：“好了，小弟弟，你手可以收回去了。”
陈晓云好奇温柔笑着问道：“师尊，弟弟这天赋如何？这测试水晶如此耀眼，弟弟的天赋是不是在天级之上呀？”洛冰儿温柔回答道：“不知道，真是可惜了，居然是五行灵根，要不是如此，就这光芒而言，天赋恐怕是达到仙级或者神级了。”
姬云生一听疑惑了，心里喃喃道：“卧槽，我这天赋，这么牛逼的吗？不过，对方怎么好像口气那么可惜，难道五行灵根有什么问题吗？不对啊，我以前看小说，五行灵根不是特别牛逼的吗？难道在这方世界，五行灵根修炼不了吗？”陈晓云一听，
温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，没关系的，就算你不能修炼，姐姐也会一直护着你的。”姬云生一听回过神来写道：“姐姐，这五行灵根修炼不了？”洛冰儿可惜的语气，温柔说道：“小弟弟，不是我打击你，在苍玄大陆的话，五行灵根的修炼之法已经失传了。
随着时间的沉淀下去，渐渐地五行灵根就被众人，默认是废灵根了。”姬云生一听无语了，心里喃喃道：“卧槽，什么？这还玩个毛线啊！哪个吊毛带我来的这个世界，赶紧把我送回去啊！他奶奶的，有那么牛逼的天赋，结果没有功法给我修炼，这开局简直绝了啊。
唉，等等，我刚才好像看见的不是五种颜色啊，这又是怎么回事？我好像不是五行灵根啊，明明颜色那么多，具体有多少我自己也不知道，难道她们没有看出来什么吗？”
content_en:
Chen Xiaoyun was speechless upon hearing this, and replied with a gentle smile: "Sister, here you go again! Can you keep mentioning this all the time? I have heard it so many times." Upon hearing this, Li Yutong asked with a look of grievance on his face: "Xiaoyun, what's the matter? After having a younger brother, has our relationship changed? You were not like this before. We are obviously so good friends."
Seeing this, Chen Xiaoyun shook his head helplessly, and said with a gentle smile: "Brother, don't believe my senior sister's expression. Senior sister is like this, she is so good at acting." Li Yutong felt a little embarrassed when he heard this, and said with a smile: "Brother, don't believe what your sister said, I am not such a person. She is such a lady, how can she be like your sister said!"
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he murmured in his heart: "I am also drunk. Why does this little girl talk so much in the film? Her acting level is simply too bad on earth. But after seeing her talk so much, the first impression I have is that she should have such a personality because she has been in the palace for a long time. She should not be a bad person, at most she is just an eccentric princess."
Li Yutong smiled and asked: "Xiaoyun, why is my brother ignoring me? Am I so unattractive?" Chen Xiaoyun was annoyed and smiled and replied gently: "Senior sister, my brother is only half a year old. You talk to him so much and he can't speak. How do you ask him to answer you?" When Li Yutong heard this, he said with a smile: "No! I think my brother can understand what we are talking about.
He must be very talented, why can't he speak? Considering how spiritual my brother is, he should be able to speak even at half a year old! Chen Xiaoyun replied with a gentle smile: "Senior sister, my brother can indeed understand what we are saying. He was only born not long ago and he can already understand what we are saying." I also asked my brother, but he didn’t even know what was going on.
How would I know? But if my brother is willing to pay attention to you, he will answer you in writing, otherwise, I have no choice. When Li Yutong heard this, he was a little surprised and asked with a smile: "Huh?" Can your brother already know how to read and write? Chen Xiaoyun replied with a gentle smile: "Yes, I just taught my brother to read for one night, and he has already learned all the basic words."
In the past six months, my brother has not only been able to read and write, but he has also learned more than 40 sets of mortal martial arts that I know. When Li Yutong heard this, he was immediately startled and said with a smile: "What a little pervert. This kind of talent is unheard of!" "At this time, Luo Bing'er's voice came and said: "You two haven't brought your little brother to the test yet, and you have been chatting all day long. "
When the two of them heard this, they stopped chatting immediately and hurriedly took Ji Yunsheng to find Luo Bing'er. From this tone, they could tell that Luo Bing'er sounded a little angry. Ten seconds passed, and the two of them took Ji Yunsheng to Luo Bing'er's dormitory. They laughed nervously and said in unison: "Hello, Master! We are late and have kept you waiting for a long time."
Luo Bing'er got angry when she saw the two of them. After all, the two little girls were more naughty and lively than herself, and she was very annoyed. Luo Bing'er walked over slowly, then raised her palm, and a crystal-like crystal appeared out of thin air. She looked at Ji Yunsheng and said gently: "Little brother, just put your hand on it and stick it to it. We will know your talent later."
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he put his little hand on the crystal. At this time, the crystal suddenly lit up. The dazzling light flickered in the room, slowly forming five colors of light: gold, red, blue, green and yellow. After a while, the intensity of the light no longer increased. Luo Bing'er said gently and somewhat regretfully: "Okay, little brother, you can take your hand back."
Chen Xiaoyun was curious and asked with a gentle smile: "Master, how is my brother's talent? This test crystal is so dazzling. Is my brother's talent above the heaven level?" LuoBing'er gently replied: "I don't know. It's a pity that it is actually the Five Elements Spiritual Root. If not for this, in terms of this light, the talent may have reached the immortal level or the god level."
Ji Yunsheng was confused when he heard this, and murmured in his heart: "Damn it, my talent is so awesome? But why does the other party seem to have such a pity tone? Is there something wrong with the Five Elements Spiritual Root? No, I read novels before, isn't the Five Elements Spiritual Root particularly awesome? Could it be that in this world, the Five Elements Spiritual Root can't be cultivated?" Chen Xiaoyun heard this,
She said with a gentle smile: "Brother, it's okay, even if you can't practice, sister will always protect you." Ji Yunsheng came back to his senses and wrote: "Sister, can't you cultivate the Five Elements Spiritual Roots?" Luo Bing'er said in a pityful tone, "Little brother, I am not attacking you. In Cangxuan Continent, the method of cultivating the Five Elements Spiritual Roots has been lost.
As time goes by, the Five Elements Spiritual Roots are gradually regarded as useless by everyone. Ji Yunsheng was speechless upon hearing this, and murmured in his heart: "F*ck, what?" This is just a joke! Who brought me to this world? Send me back quickly! His grandma had such an incredible talent, but she didn’t have any techniques for me to practice. This was an incredible start.
Oh, wait, I didn’t seem to see five colors just now. What’s going on? I don’t seem to have the Five Elements Spiritual Root. There are obviously so many colors, but I don’t know how many there are specifically. Didn’t they see something? "
